customer_question: Is a new SIG registration limited to just one model, or can we register multiple models at once?
question_variants: Can we add several models in our initial new registration?
Does SIG only allow one model per new registration?
What's the recommended way to register more than one model?
actual_issue: The customer needed to know whether SIG's new-registration process restricted them to registering only one model, since they wanted to understand their options for covering multiple models under the new registration.
plain_english_explanation: Bluetooth SIG requires that a new registration include at least one model, not exactly one -- so technically more than one model can be added during the initial registration. In practice, though, it's usually better to register just the first model up front and add any additional models afterward through a separate, free process, because mistakes made in the model list during the busier initial registration can only be deleted by SIG, not corrected, whereas adding models later is simpler and lower-risk.
consultant_answer: SIG's rule is that a new registration must include at least one model added to the Product List -- this is a minimum, not a maximum, so registering multiple models at the time of new registration is not prohibited. However, because new registration already involves a substantial amount of other input and confirmation, and because any incorrectly-entered Product List item can only be requested for deletion by SIG (not corrected), the general practice is to register just one model during new registration, then use the free additional-model registration entry point that becomes available on the Product List page after registration completes to calmly add further models.
decision_logic: Since SIG's new-registration requirement is a floor (at least one model), not a ceiling, multiple models could technically be included at once, but the asymmetry between mis-entries being uncorrectable (only deletable) and the simplicity of the free post-registration addition process makes registering one model first, then adding others afterward, the lower-risk default approach.
final_recommendation: Register a single model during the initial new registration, then add any additional models afterward through the free Product-List addition entry point, rather than attempting to include multiple models in the initial registration.
risk_if_done_wrong: Including multiple models in the initial new registration increases the chance of a Product List entry error, which cannot be corrected after the fact -- only deleted by SIG -- creating avoidable rework compared to using the free post-registration addition process.
